questions.question: Even though there was nothing to gain, what did the apostle Paul say he would go on to boast about?

answers.text: Visions and revelations from the Lord
Praise he got from the other churches
His years of training as a Pharisee

questions.question: What did the apostle Paul say he was given to keep him from becoming conceited?
Paul pleaded three times for the Lord to take a torment away from him. What did the Lord say to him?

answers.text: My grace is sufficient for you
Keep pleading and wait on Me
I will take it away in time

questions.question: Why did the apostle Paul say he would boast all the more gladly in his weaknesses?

answers.text: So the power of Christ may rest on him
So the Corinthians will pray for him
So the false apostles will stop bragging
